name: Rebekah
summary: The woman God led Abraham's servant to as a wife for Isaac. She was the mother of Esau and Jacob, and she helped Jacob take his father's blessing.

key_moments.title: Draws Water for the Camels
key_moments.description: Abraham's servant prayed for a sign at a well, and Rebekah came and offered water to him and his camels. She turned out to be from Abraham's own family.

key_moments.title: Agrees to Go and Marry Isaac
key_moments.description: Her family asked Rebekah if she would go with Abraham's servant, and she said she would. She traveled to Isaac, became his wife, and he loved her.

key_moments.title: Carries Struggling Twins
key_moments.description: Rebekah had no children until Isaac prayed for her. Her twins struggled inside her, and the LORD told her the older would serve the younger.

key_moments.title: Prepares Jacob to Take the Blessing
key_moments.description: Rebekah heard Isaac planning to bless Esau. She had Jacob bring goats, cooked the food his father loved, and dressed Jacob in Esau's clothes to receive the blessing.

key_moments.title: Sending Jacob Away
key_moments.description: When Rebekah heard that Esau planned to kill Jacob, she told Jacob to flee to her brother Laban in Haran.
